profile_text.body:
Khosla Ventures is a for-profit firm founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, California, according to the profile information held about it. Its website describes it as investing in the company best positioned to harness AI's exponential advances to build beneficial, human-aligned intelligence, and it also describes backing a finance workflow platform that leverages proprietary data and AI talent.

The site's commentary takes an optimistic position on AI, stating that AI will do 80% of the economically valuable work humans do today, for 80% of all jobs, faster than most believe, and that 80% of 80% of all economically valuable jobs will be capable of being done by AI. It also discusses Yann LeCun's view that the risk of AI taking over is miniscule, and refers to OpenAI among the disruptive innovations the author has studied.

The held facts list no products and no MCP servers for the company, and no cases. California is recorded as the jurisdiction for its law exposure, with a count of 281.
